_about: SUBSIDE H2I OPERA DISP-S1 pipeline (Pipeline A) modeled for the svo-adapter. Like WERC, SUBSIDE runs it as ONE Tapis job (STAGE=run on subside-h2i-opera-analysis: discover + download + preview + zip; see subside/tapis/workflows/pipelines/h2i-opera.yaml). The adapter submits that single job (run-h2i) unchanged, then chains the load tail (publish + stac-publish). The stac-publish piece is shared with WERC; publish is H2I-specific because its contract is displacement-product.

transform_specs.name: run-h2i
transform_specs.description: The full SUBSIDE H2I analysis as ONE Tapis job (discover + download + crop + preview overlay + zip, via STAGE=run). The adapter submits this unchanged.

transform_specs.name: publish
transform_specs.description: Emit the unified subside-run-manifest.json describing the run's products.

transform_specs.name: stac-publish
transform_specs.description: Dual-write the product to the CKAN FileStore + the STAC API (stacmap.publish, the stac-platform backend) as one discoverable Item. Shared by BOTH SUBSIDE pipelines.

product_pattern.description: Comma-separated filename patterns of the products to publish: the WERC cumulative and velocity GeoTIFFs, or the H2I displacement COG with its overlay. The piece is shared by both pipelines, so one default covers both.

source_data_object.label: Houston AOI displacement request (AOI + date range), 2024
source_data_object.description: An area-of-interest + date range, fed into the single H2I job.

target_model_input._about: A downloaded, previewable displacement product — exactly what the single H2I job produces. Plan = [run-h2i]: one job, done.

target_model_input_cataloged._about: Same product, made DISCOVERABLE in CKAN + STAC. The target-side catalog requirement lives in this variant's own `catalog` key (a plain target has none, which _check_catalog treats as no constraint). Plan = [run-h2i, stac-publish]: one job, then the catalog load on the end.
